title: Northbeam Circle Membership: Dues, Enrolment Fee and Billing Frequency Schedule
content:
## Dues and enrolment figures, by tier

Every tier of Northbeam Circle Membership carries its own dues figures. The annual dues figure is the
membership dues billed for a full term; the monthly dues figure is the dues where monthly billing is
offered on the tier, and it stands at 0.00 where the tier is annual only or free. The enrolment
fee is the one-off amount charged when the membership is opened. The trial days are the days of full
benefits that run before the first dues charge is booked. The invoice terms are the days a business
invoice for dues may run before it is treated as unpaid. The renewal notice days are the days before a
renewal on which the renewal notice is sent.

| Tier | Annual dues (USD) | Monthly dues (USD) | Enrolment fee (USD) | Trial days | Invoice terms (days) | Renewal notice (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 49.99 | 4.99 | 0.00 | 14 | 0 | 21 |
| Circle Total Annual | 179.99 | 17.99 | 0.00 | 30 | 0 | 30 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 219.99 | 21.99 | 0.00 | 30 | 0 | 30 |
| Circle Business Pro | 299.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 0 | 30 | 45 |
| Circle Business Elite | 1199.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 45 | 45 |

## Billing frequencies and settlement methods recorded for each tier

| Tier | Frequencies offered | Dues settlement methods | Automatic renewal on opening |
|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | none | not applicable | no |
| Circle Plus Annual | annual or monthly | card on file or store credit | yes |
| Circle Total Annual | annual or monthly | card on file or store credit | yes |
| Circle Total Household Annual | annual or monthly | card on file or store credit | yes |
| Circle Business Pro | annual | card on file, store credit or business invoice | yes |
| Circle Business Elite | annual | card on file, store credit or business invoice | yes |

## Reading the two dues figures together

The monthly figure is not one twelfth of the annual figure, and the difference follows from the schedule
itself. On Circle Plus Annual twelve monthly charges of 4.99 come to 59.88, which is 9.89 above the
annual figure of 49.99. On Circle Total Annual twelve monthly charges of 17.99 come to 215.88, which is
35.89 above the annual figure of 179.99. On Circle Total Household Annual twelve monthly charges of
21.99 come to 263.88, which is 43.89 above the annual figure of 219.99. On the three tiers offered
annually only — Circle Free Membership, Circle Business Pro and Circle Business Elite — the monthly
figure stands at 0.00 and no monthly comparison arises.

Circle Business Pro is the one tier carrying an enrolment fee, at 25.00. Circle Free Membership,
Circle Business Pro and Circle Business Elite carry no trial days, so on those tiers no trial period
runs before the first dues charge.
